rules: Central registry status is copied without upgrade.
Participant-collected public sources remain bounded background or case-comparison material unless separately reviewed.
Package-authored evidence supports proposal method and design intent, not external facts.
Access or publication dates do not prove present field conditions.
Any stale, inaccessible or conflicting source stops the affected claim and triggers human source review.

refresh_execution_this_round.reason: No new factual claim requires a live refresh; the round focuses on package convergence, component licensing and professional handoff.
refresh_execution_this_round.next_trigger: A changed source, new external claim, G1 application, official geometry release or maintainer request.
